title: Debiasing Personal Identities in Toxicity Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating toxicity classification performance on race-specific subgroup comments (e.g., Black, White) using threshold-agnostic metrics like Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC (Background Positive, Subgroup Negative), and BNSP AUC (Background Negative, Subgroup Positive).
Evaluating toxicity classification performance on religion-specific subgroup comments (e.g., Muslim, Jewish, Christian) using threshold-agnostic metrics like Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC.
Evaluating toxicity classification performance on sexual orientation-specific subgroup comments (e.g., homosexual) using threshold-agnostic metrics like Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC.
Evaluating toxicity classification performance on gender-specific subgroup comments (e.g., Male, Female) using threshold-agnostic metrics like Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC.
Evaluating toxicity classification performance on mental illness-specific subgroup comments using threshold-agnostic metrics like Subgroup AUC, BPSN AUC, and BNSP AUC.
